subject: general
question: Who is the author of the book ‘The Great Indian Novel’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shashi Tharoor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Shashi Tharoor is the author of "The Great Indian Novel".
 
• He is the winner of the Commonwealth Writers Prize and Head of the Department of Public Information of the United Nations respectively.
 
• The novel is a fictional story, combined with the epic Mahabharata and the history of Indian independence.
 
• The novel consists of eighteen books.
